bias.en: Bearish · SAR flipped bullish, capped under $1,530
bias.zh: 看空 · 抛物线 SAR 转多，受制于 $1,530 下方

read.en: ASML fell 0.4% on Nov 10 to $1,507.85, trading $1,492.00–1,545.71. It is above the 5-day ($1,459.8) and below the 10-day ($1,528.2), 30-day ($1,651.6), 100-day ($1,716.7) and 200-day ($1,601.2); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR flipped bullish on Nov 10 ($1,355.05), and RSI is 43.

No level changed: the $1,545.71 high pierced the 10-day and the $1,530.6 Jul 29 low, but the close slipped back below, and the $1,468–1,479 support held. Resistance is $1,528–1,531 (10-day, Jul 29 low), then $1,545.7–1,547 (Nov 10 high, Nov 3 low) and $1,575.6. Support is $1,468–1,492, then $1,443.5–1,459.8 (Nov 5–6 highs, 5-day) and $1,409.2. A close above $1,547 would target $1,576; below $1,468, $1,444–1,460.
